item.title: Off-highway’s electric shift: why voltage, modularity and e-hydraulics matter
item.description: Electrification of off-highway vehicles isn’t new. item.title: Heilind adds Molex SideWize high-voltage connectors for space-constrained EV charging systems
item.description: Heilind Electronics is adding the Molex SideWize High-Voltage Connectors to its portfolio of high-power interconnect solutions. The connectors target space-constrained, high-power designs where engineers are balancing packaging, electrical safety and power density in power-distribution hardware, like EV charging systems, data-center power shelves, UPS equipment and industrial automation. item.description: EVgo is expanding deployment of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) connectors across its public DC fast-charging network.
